CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA

&

Monday, October 2, 2017
06:30 p.m.
ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING 5:30 P.M.: CANCELLED
REGULAR MEETING 6:30 P.M.:
CALL TO ORDER: Council Chambers
INVOCATION: City Attorney Jones
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Mayor Pro Tem Shaw
ROLL CALL:
CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT:
I.
PROCLAMATIONS/PRESENTATIONS: None at this time.
II.
PUBLIC COMMENTS:
This is the time for the public to address any item of City Council/Authority/Agency business NOT appearing on this Agenda. Speakers must limit their comments to three (3) minutes each. The total time period for public comment is 30 minutes.
(Note: Per Government Code Section 54954.3(a), the City Council/Authority/Agency cannot take action or express a consensus of approval or disapproval on any public comments regarding matters which do not appear on the printed agenda.)
III.
CONSENT CALENDAR:
All matters on Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion unless a Councilmember/Director or member of the audience requests separate action or removal of an item. Removed items will be considered following the Consent Calendar portion of this agenda. Members of the audience will have the opportunity to address Authority on removed items at that time. Speakers must limit their comments to three (3) minutes each.
A.
PROPOSED ITEMS:
1.
PROCEDURAL WAIVER: Waive reading in full of resolutions and ordinances and approval and adoption of same by reading title only.
2.
APPROVE SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 1785 ENTITLED: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA APPROVING AMENDMENTS TO TITLE 5 "BUSINESS TAXES, LICENSES AND REGULATIONS", SECTION 5.04.610 "SEASONAL COMMERCIAL SALES LOTS", DEFINING THE TYPE OF ACTIVITIES REGULATED AND APPROVAL PROCESS PER EXHIBIT "A."
III2 CD Ord1785
3.
Approve the issuance of an Easement Deed to Southern California Edison across a portion of the Police Department parking lot; and authorize staff to send the Easement Deed to the County of Orange for recordation.
III3 PW SCE EasemtdeedPD
4.
Approve an amendment of the Police Department Fiscal Year 2017- 2018 Budget to consolidate two Bureau Manager positions into one Administrative Bureau Manager position and increasing the salary of the new position to be competitive with local cities.
III4 PD BureauMgr PosCons
5.
Approve Amendment No. 1 to JMDiaz Inc. for the Professional Engineering Services Contract for the La Habra Union Pacific Rail Line Bikeway Project; and approve a budget appropriation from Measure M2 Fair Share of $274,706 to fully fund the Project.
III5 PW UPRR ConsultAmend1
6.
WARRANTS: Approve Nos. 00113239 through 00113548 totaling $1,798,723.44.
III6 FAS Warrant's 20171003
IV.
CONSENT CALENDAR ITEMS REMOVED FOR SEPARATE DISCUSSION:
V.
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
NOTE: If a challenge is made by any party in court from actions arising out of a public hearing, you may be limited to raising only those issues you or someone else raised at the public hearing described in this notice or in written correspondence delivered at the public hearing or prior thereto.
1.
Duly noticed public hearing to consider an urgency interim ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Habra extending amended provisions of Title 18 (The Zoning Code) prohibiting the development of marijuana related uses for a final one (1) year period.
a.
APPROVE AND ADOPT URGENCY INTERIM ORDINANCE NO. ______ ENTITLED: EXTENSION OF AN URGENCY INTERIM ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING PROVISIONS OF TITLE 18 (THE ZONING CODE) PROHIBITING THE DEVELOPMENT OF MARIJUANA RELATED USES FOR ONE (1) FINAL YEAR.
b.
Authorize the City Manager to retain a consultant in an amount not to exceed $100,000 to assist in the research and development of standards for the possible establishment of marijuana related uses within the City, for City Council consideration.
c.
Approve the appropriation of $100,000 from the City's available General Fund fund balance to fund the cost of a consultant to assist staff.

VI.
CONSIDERATION ITEMS:
Any member of the audience may request to address the City Council/Authority/Agency on any Consideration Item, prior to the City Council/Authority/Agency taking a final vote on the Item. The Mayor will invite interested persons to come forward to the podium and speak as each Item is called. Speakers must limit their comments to three (3) minutes each.
1.
Consider an ordinance for adoption and read the title of the ordinance to amend Title 15 "Building and Construction" of the La Habra Municipal Code Chapter 15.46 adopting the 2017 County of Los Angeles Fire Code, and setting November 6, 2017, for a public hearing on the proposed ordinance.
a.
Approve setting the public hearing date of November 6, 2017, in the Council Chambers located at 100 E. La Habra Boulevard, La Habra, California for consideration of an ORDINANCE ENTITLED: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA AMENDING TITLE 15 "BUILDING AND CONSTRUCTION" OF THE LA HABRA MUNICIPAL CODE, CHAPTER 15.46, ADOPTING THE 2017 COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES FIRE CODE.

VIII.

IX.

X.
ADJOURNMENT: Adjourned to Monday, October 16, 2017, at 5:30 p.m. in the Council Closed Session Room 112c, 100 E. La Habra Boulevard, followed by the Regular Meeting at 6:30 p.m. in the City Council Chambers.
Except as otherwise provided by law, no action shall be taken on any item not appearing in the foregoing agenda. A copy of the full agenda packet is available for public review at the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours or on the City's webpage at http://www.lahabraca.gov/.
Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the City Council/Authority/Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at 110 East La Habra Boulevard, La Habra, during normal business hours
In accordance with the Federal Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, should you require a disability-related modification or accommodation, including auxiliary aids or services to participate in the meeting due to a disability, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (562) 383-4030.
